<!--
  ============================================================
  SMELL DISCETTES - ONLINE-TEST
  Diesen kompletten Block in ein Elementor-HTML-Widget einfuegen.
  Enthaelt Schrift und Bilder eingebettet - keine externen Dateien noetig.
  Container auf volle Breite stellen, Padding auf 0.
  ============================================================
-->
<style>
@font-face{font-family:'LatoSD';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'LatoSD';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'LatoSD';font-style:normal;font-weight:900;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}

/* ---------- 1. Kapselung / Reset -------------------------------- */
.sdx, .sdx *, .sdx *::before, .sdx *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.sdx * {
  margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0;
  background: transparent; box-shadow: none;
  font: inherit; line-height: inherit; color: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit; word-spacing: inherit; text-align: inherit;
  text-transform: none; text-decoration: none; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none;
  list-style: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: normal;
  float: none; max-width: none; min-width: 0;
}
.sdx img, .sdx svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.sdx a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.sdx button { cursor: pointer; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; }
.sdx strong, .sdx b { font-weight: 700; }
.sdx i, .sdx em { font-style: italic; }

/* ---------- 2. Design-Tokens ------------------------------------ */
.sdx {
  --blue:        #407BA0;
  --blue-deep:   #31637F;
  --blue-light:  #6098BA;   /* Hover: heller statt dunkler */
  --blue-soft:   #BCD3E5;
  --blue-mist:   #EDF4F9;
  --navy:        #00102E;
  --navy-2:      #12294A;
  --ink:         #16233A;
  --muted:       #5C6E85;
  --line:        #E1EAF2;
  --tint:        #F5F9FC;
  --white:       #FFFFFF;
  --red:         #D8362C;

  --wrap: 1200px;
  --r-sm: 8px;
  --r-md: 14px;
  --r-lg: 22px;
  --sh-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,16,46,.05), 0 8px 24px -14px rgba(0,16,46,.18);
  --sh-md: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,16,46,.05), 0 22px 48px -24px rgba(0,16,46,.30);

  font-family: 'LatoSD', 'Lato', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-variant: normal;
  line-height: 1.65;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  word-spacing: normal;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: none;
  direction: ltr;
  background: var(--white);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  overflow: hidden;           /* verhindert horizontales Überlaufen in Elementor */
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* ---------- 3. Bausteine ---------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-wrap { width: 100%; max-width: var(--wrap); margin: 0 auto; padding-left: 28px; padding-right: 28px; }
.sdx .sd-sec  { padding: clamp(64px, 8vw, 116px) 0; }

.sdx .sd-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue);
}
.sdx .sd-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 26px; height: 2px; background: var(--blue-soft); }

.sdx .sd-h2 {
  font-size: clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 46px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.14;
  letter-spacing: -.021em; color: var(--navy); margin-top: 18px;
}
.sdx .sd-h3 { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.012em; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-lead { font-size: clamp(17px, 1.25vw, 19px); color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.72; }
.sdx .sd-head { max-width: 720px; }
.sdx .sd-h2 + .sd-lead { margin-top: 18px; }

.sdx .sd-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 15px 28px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .012em; line-height: 1.2;
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
}
.sdx .sd-btn--primary { background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(64,123,160,.85); }
.sdx .sd-btn--primary:hover { background: var(--blue-light); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -14px rgba(96,152,186,.85); }
.sdx .sd-btn--ghost { color: var(--navy); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(0,16,46,.16); }
.sdx .sd-btn--ghost:hover { background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--blue-soft); color: var(--blue-deep); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.sdx .sd-btn--light { background: var(--white); color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-btn--light:hover { background: var(--blue-mist); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(0,16,46,.45); }
.sdx .sd-btn--onNavy { color: var(--white); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.32); }
.sdx .sd-btn--onNavy:hover { background: rgba(188,211,229,.16); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(188,211,229,.85); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.sdx .sd-btn__arrow { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ---------- 4. Header ------------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(8px); }
.sdx .sd-header__in { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 84px; }
.sdx .sd-header__logo img { height: 52px; width: auto; }
.sdx .sd-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; margin-left: auto; }
.sdx .sd-nav a { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); position: relative; padding: 6px 0; }
.sdx .sd-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--blue); transition: right .25s ease; }
.sdx .sd-nav a:hover { color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-nav a:hover::after { right: 0; }
.sdx .sd-lang { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-lang a { padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 6px; }
.sdx .sd-lang a:hover { color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-mist); }
.sdx .sd-lang .is-active { color: var(--navy); background: var(--blue-mist); }
.sdx .sd-lang span { color: var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-header .sd-btn { padding: 12px 22px; font-size: 14px; }

/* ---------- 5. Hero --------------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-hero { position: relative; isolation: isolate; background: var(--tint); }
.sdx .sd-hero__media { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; }
.sdx .sd-hero__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 78% 50%; }
.sdx .sd-hero__veil {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(96deg, #FFFFFF 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.97) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.80) 46%, rgba(255,255,255,.20) 62%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 74%);
}
.sdx .sd-hero__in { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding-top: clamp(72px, 8vw, 112px); padding-bottom: clamp(72px, 8vw, 112px); min-height: 660px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.sdx .sd-hero__col { max-width: 620px; }
.sdx .sd-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 15px 7px 11px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--white); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line), var(--sh-sm);
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-deep);
}
.sdx .sd-pill i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(64,123,160,.16); }
.sdx .sd-hero h1 {
  margin-top: 26px;
  font-size: clamp(38px, 4.7vw, 62px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.06;
  letter-spacing: -.03em; color: var(--navy);
}
.sdx .sd-hero h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-hero__lead { margin-top: 24px; font-size: clamp(17px, 1.3vw, 19.5px); line-height: 1.72; color: var(--muted); max-width: 560px; }
.sdx .sd-hero__cta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin-top: 36px; }
.sdx .sd-hero__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; margin-top: 40px; }
.sdx .sd-hero__meta img { height: 40px; width: auto; }
.sdx .sd-hero__meta ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 20px; }
.sdx .sd-hero__meta li { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.sdx .sd-hero__meta li::before { content: ""; width: 15px; height: 15px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--blue-soft); }

/* ---------- 6. Kennzahlen --------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-stats { background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); }
.sdx .sd-stats__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
.sdx .sd-stat { padding: 46px 34px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); }
.sdx .sd-stat:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
.sdx .sd-stat:last-child { padding-right: 0; }
.sdx .sd-stat b { display: block; font-size: clamp(32px, 3vw, 42px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.028em; color: var(--white); }
.sdx .sd-stat span { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.sdx .sd-stat span u { text-decoration: none; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; }

/* ---------- 7. Karten ------------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-grid3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 26px; margin-top: 56px; }
.sdx .sd-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 38px 34px 40px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line), var(--sh-sm);
  transition: transform .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
.sdx .sd-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,16,46,.04), 0 22px 48px -26px rgba(64,123,160,.55); }
.sdx .sd-card__pikto { height: 132px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; }
.sdx .sd-card__pikto img { max-height: 132px; width: auto; }
.sdx .sd-card__label { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-card h3 { margin-top: 10px; }
.sdx .sd-card p { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-card cite { display: block; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 24px; font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.sdx .sd-card cite::before { content: ""; display: block; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin-bottom: 16px; }

/* ---------- 8. Anwendung ---------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-steps { background: var(--tint); }
.sdx .sd-steps__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 56px; }
.sdx .sd-step { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 34px 32px 36px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); position: relative; }
.sdx .sd-step__fig { height: 190px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: var(--r-md); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--blue-mist), #FFFFFF); }
.sdx .sd-step__fig img { max-height: 154px; width: auto; }
.sdx .sd-step__no {
  position: absolute; top: 24px; left: 24px;
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--navy); color: var(--white);
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0;
}
.sdx .sd-step h3 { margin-top: 26px; }
.sdx .sd-step p { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-notes { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 30px; }
.sdx .sd-notes li {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 13px 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);
  font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink);
}
.sdx .sd-notes li::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue); }

/* ---------- 9. Präoperativ -------------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.92fr 1fr; gap: clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px); align-items: center; }
.sdx .sd-split__fig { position: relative; }
.sdx .sd-split__fig img { border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 4.6; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 24%; }
.sdx .sd-quotebox {
  position: absolute; right: -28px; bottom: -30px; width: 268px;
  background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 24px 26px 26px; box-shadow: var(--sh-md);
}
.sdx .sd-quotebox b { display: block; font-size: 42px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.sdx .sd-quotebox span { display: block; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: rgba(255,255,255,.88); }
.sdx .sd-checks { margin-top: 30px; display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.sdx .sd-checks li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-checks li b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.sdx .sd-checks li::before {
  content: "✓"; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--blue-mist); color: var(--blue-deep);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; margin-top: 2px;
}
.sdx .sd-source { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .01em; }

/* ---------- 10. Evidenz (dunkel) -------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-evid { background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,.74); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.sdx .sd-evid::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: -220px; right: -180px; width: 640px; height: 640px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(64,123,160,.36), rgba(64,123,160,0) 68%);
}
.sdx .sd-evid .sd-wrap { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.sdx .sd-evid .sd-h2 { color: var(--white); }
.sdx .sd-evid .sd-eyebrow { color: var(--blue-soft); }
.sdx .sd-evid .sd-eyebrow::before { background: rgba(188,211,229,.45); }
.sdx .sd-evid .sd-lead { color: rgba(255,255,255,.70); }
.sdx .sd-pubs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 22px; margin-top: 52px; }
.sdx .sd-pub { padding: 32px 32px 34px; border-radius: var(--r-md); background: rgba(255,255,255,.045); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.10); }
.sdx .sd-pub__j { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-soft); }
.sdx .sd-pub h3 { margin-top: 12px; color: var(--white); font-size: 19px; }
.sdx .sd-pub p { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; }
.sdx .sd-evid__foot { margin-top: 30px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.52); }

/* ---------- 11. Abschluss-CTA ----------------------------------- */
.sdx .sd-cta { background: var(--tint); }
.sdx .sd-cta__box {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line), var(--sh-md);
  padding: clamp(44px, 5vw, 68px) clamp(32px, 5vw, 72px);
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 40px; align-items: center;
}
.sdx .sd-cta__box .sd-h2 { margin-top: 16px; }
.sdx .sd-cta__box p { margin-top: 16px; max-width: 560px; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-cta__btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin-top: 32px; }
.sdx .sd-cta__mascot { width: 210px; }
.sdx .sd-cta__mascot img { width: 100%; }

/* ---------- 12. Footer ------------------------------------------ */
.sdx .sd-footer { background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,.62); padding: 72px 0 34px; }
.sdx .sd-footer__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 44px; }
.sdx .sd-footer__logo img { height: 62px; width: auto; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity: .95; }
.sdx .sd-footer__grid p { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 300px; }
.sdx .sd-footer h4 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--white); }
.sdx .sd-footer ul { margin-top: 18px; display: grid; gap: 11px; }
.sdx .sd-footer li a, .sdx .sd-footer li { font-size: 14.5px; }
.sdx .sd-footer li a:hover { color: var(--white); }
.sdx .sd-footer__bar {
  margin-top: 56px; padding-top: 26px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 26px; align-items: center;
  font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45);
}
.sdx .sd-footer__bar nav { margin-left: auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 22px; }
.sdx .sd-footer__bar a:hover { color: var(--white); }

/* ---------- 13. Responsive -------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .sdx .sd-grid3, .sdx .sd-steps__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-stats__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-stat { padding: 34px 28px; }
  .sdx .sd-stat:nth-child(odd) { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
  .sdx .sd-stat:nth-child(1), .sdx .sd-stat:nth-child(2) { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); }
  .sdx .sd-footer__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 36px; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .sdx { font-size: 16px; }
  .sdx .sd-hero { background: var(--white); }
  .sdx .sd-hero__media { position: static; }
  .sdx .sd-hero__media img { height: auto; aspect-ratio: 5 / 4; object-position: 76% 50%; }
  .sdx .sd-hero__veil { display: none; }
  .sdx .sd-hero__in { min-height: 0; padding-top: 48px; padding-bottom: 56px; }
  .sdx .sd-hero__col { max-width: none; }
  .sdx .sd-split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-quotebox { right: 16px; bottom: -22px; width: 240px; }
  .sdx .sd-pubs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-cta__box { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-cta__mascot { width: 150px; }
  .sdx .sd-nav { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .sdx .sd-wrap { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; }
  .sdx .sd-grid3, .sdx .sd-steps__grid, .sdx .sd-stats__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-stat { border-left: 0 !important; padding: 28px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); }
  .sdx .sd-stat:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .sdx .sd-header__in { height: 72px; gap: 16px; }
  .sdx .sd-header__logo img { height: 44px; }
  .sdx .sd-header .sd-btn { display: none; }
  .sdx .sd-lang { margin-left: auto; }
  .sdx .sd-btn { width: 100%; }
  .sdx .sd-card, .sdx .sd-step { padding: 30px 26px 32px; }
  .sdx .sd-footer__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-footer__bar nav { margin-left: 0; }
}

/* ================================================================
   14. Bausteine für die Unterseiten (Produkt, Über uns)
   ================================================================ */

/* --- Seitenkopf (kompakter als der Startseiten-Hero) --- */
.sdx .sd-phero { background: var(--tint); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: clamp(52px, 6vw, 86px) 0; }
.sdx .sd-phero__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr .92fr; gap: clamp(36px, 5vw, 72px); align-items: center; }
.sdx .sd-phero h1 { margin-top: 20px; font-size: clamp(34px, 4.1vw, 54px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.028em; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-phero h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-phero .sd-lead { margin-top: 22px; }
.sdx .sd-phero__cta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin-top: 32px; }
.sdx .sd-phero__fig img { width: 100%; border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }

/* --- Fliesstext --- */
.sdx .sd-prose { max-width: 780px; }
.sdx .sd-prose p { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.78; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-prose p + p { margin-top: 20px; }
.sdx .sd-prose strong { color: var(--ink); }

/* --- Begriffskarten --- */
.sdx .sd-terms { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; margin-top: 40px; }
.sdx .sd-term { padding: 26px 28px 28px; border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--blue-mist); }
.sdx .sd-term b { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--navy); letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.sdx .sd-term span { display: block; margin-top: 9px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.62; color: var(--muted); }

/* --- Bild mit Bildunterschrift --- */
.sdx .sd-fig img { width: 100%; border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }
.sdx .sd-fig figcaption { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); }

/* --- Zweispaltiges Raster --- */
.sdx .sd-grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; margin-top: 52px; }

/* --- Tabelle für Artikelangaben --- */
.sdx .sd-tablewrap { margin-top: 44px; overflow-x: auto; }
.sdx .sd-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.sdx .sd-table th {
  text-align: left; padding: 0 20px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sdx .sd-table th:first-child, .sdx .sd-table td:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.sdx .sd-table th:last-child,  .sdx .sd-table td:last-child  { padding-right: 0; }
.sdx .sd-table td { padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); vertical-align: middle; }
.sdx .sd-table td b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.sdx .sd-table .sd-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; }
.sdx .sd-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--tint); }

/* --- Nummernplakette für die Disketten --- */
.sdx .sd-disc {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; flex: none;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft);
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--blue-deep);
}
.sdx .sd-discrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }

/* --- Hinweiszeile --- */
.sdx .sd-note {
  margin-top: 26px; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);
  font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--muted);
}
.sdx .sd-note b { color: var(--ink); }

/* --- Zeitstrahl --- */
.sdx .sd-tl { margin-top: 52px; }
.sdx .sd-tl__item { position: relative; padding: 0 0 44px 96px; }
.sdx .sd-tl__item::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 29px; top: 62px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-tl__item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
.sdx .sd-tl__item:last-child::before { display: none; }
.sdx .sd-tl__dot {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--white); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--blue-soft);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--blue-deep); text-align: center;
}
.sdx .sd-tl__item.is-now .sd-tl__dot { background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(64,123,160,.9); }
.sdx .sd-tl h3 { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.012em; color: var(--navy); padding-top: 12px; }
.sdx .sd-tl p { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.72; color: var(--muted); max-width: 720px; }

/* --- Team --- */
.sdx .sd-team { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 26px; margin-top: 56px; }
.sdx .sd-person img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; object-fit: cover; border-radius: var(--r-md); box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); }
.sdx .sd-person h3 { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-person span { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }

/* --- Publikationsliste --- */
.sdx .sd-publist { margin-top: 46px; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.sdx .sd-publist li {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px 1fr; gap: 22px; align-items: start;
  padding: 26px 30px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--white); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);
  transition: box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.sdx .sd-publist li:hover { background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft); }
.sdx .sd-publist .sd-pubno { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--blue); letter-spacing: .08em; padding-top: 3px; }
.sdx .sd-publist h3 { font-size: 17.5px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-publist span { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }

/* --- Aktive Seite in der Navigation --- */
.sdx .sd-nav a.is-current { color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-nav a.is-current::after { right: 0; }

/* --- Responsive für die Unterseiten --- */
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .sdx .sd-team { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-terms { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .sdx .sd-phero__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-phero__fig { order: -1; }
  .sdx .sd-grid2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .sdx .sd-tablewrap { overflow-x: visible; }
  .sdx .sd-table, .sdx .sd-table tbody, .sdx .sd-table tr, .sdx .sd-table td { display: block; width: 100%; }
  .sdx .sd-table thead { display: none; }
  .sdx .sd-table tr { padding: 22px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .sdx .sd-table tr:hover { background: transparent; }
  .sdx .sd-table td { padding: 5px 0; border: 0; }
  .sdx .sd-table td::before {
    content: attr(data-label); display: block; margin-bottom: 3px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue);
  }
  .sdx .sd-table td:first-child::before { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .sdx .sd-team { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-tl__item { padding-left: 74px; padding-bottom: 36px; }
  .sdx .sd-tl__dot { width: 48px; height: 48px; font-size: 12px; }
  .sdx .sd-tl__item::before { left: 23px; top: 52px; }
  .sdx .sd-publist li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; padding: 24px 24px; }
}

/* --- Textbetonter Zweispalter (Fliesstext links, Bild rechts) --- */
.sdx .sd-split--text { grid-template-columns: 1.06fr .82fr; align-items: start; }
.sdx .sd-split--text .sd-fig { position: sticky; top: 32px; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .sdx .sd-split--text { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-split--text .sd-fig { position: static; }
}

/* --- Artikelnummern nicht umbrechen --- */
.sdx .sd-table td:first-child b, .sdx .sd-table td b.sd-art { white-space: nowrap; }

/* ================================================================
   16. Transparenter Header über dem Herobild
   Eigene Modifier (--glass), damit Variante B mit ihrem
   --float-Modifier unberührt bleibt.
   ================================================================ */
.sdx { position: relative; }
.sdx .sd-header--glass {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 6;
  background: transparent; backdrop-filter: none; border-bottom: 0;
}
.sdx .sd-header--glass .sd-header__in { height: 100px; }
.sdx .sd-header--glass .sd-header__logo img { height: 56px; }
.sdx .sd-header--glass .sd-lang .is-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.72); }

/* Hero: Bildebene nach rechts versetzt, damit der Text auf einer
   ruhigen Fläche liegt und die Packung frei steht. */
.sdx .sd-hero--glass .sd-hero__media { left: 18%; right: -2%; }
.sdx .sd-hero--glass .sd-hero__media img { object-position: 62% 50%; }
.sdx .sd-hero--glass .sd-hero__veil {
  background: linear-gradient(96deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFFFF 33%, rgba(255,255,255,.92) 45%, rgba(255,255,255,.30) 62%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 74%);
}
.sdx .sd-hero--glass { background: #FFFFFF; }
.sdx .sd-hero--glass .sd-hero__in { min-height: 760px; padding-top: clamp(150px, 13vw, 196px); }
.sdx .sd-hero--glass .sd-hero__col { max-width: 600px; }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  /* Auf schmalen Geräten läuft der Header wieder mit, sonst verdeckt er das Bild */
  .sdx .sd-header--glass { position: static; background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .sdx .sd-header--glass .sd-header__in { height: 84px; }
  .sdx .sd-hero--glass .sd-hero__in { min-height: 0; padding-top: 48px; }
}

/* ================================================================
   17. Bausteine für Kontakt-, Partner- und Rechtsseiten
   ================================================================ */
.sdx .sd-contact { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .95fr 1.05fr; gap: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px); align-items: start; margin-top: 56px; }

.sdx .sd-infolist { display: grid; gap: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-infolist > div { padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 132px 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; }
.sdx .sd-infolist dt { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-infolist dd { font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink); }
.sdx .sd-infolist dd a { color: var(--blue-deep); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-soft); }
.sdx .sd-infolist dd a:hover { color: var(--blue); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-infolist dd span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14.5px; margin-top: 4px; }

.sdx .sd-formcard { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line), var(--sh-sm); }
.sdx .sd-form { display: grid; gap: 20px; margin-top: 26px; }
.sdx .sd-form__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; }
.sdx .sd-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.sdx .sd-field label { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-field input, .sdx .sd-field textarea, .sdx .sd-field select {
  width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: var(--tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);
  font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink);
  transition: box-shadow .18s ease, background-color .18s ease;
}
.sdx .sd-field textarea { min-height: 132px; resize: vertical; }
.sdx .sd-field input:focus, .sdx .sd-field textarea:focus, .sdx .sd-field select:focus {
  background: var(--white); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue);
}
.sdx .sd-field input::placeholder, .sdx .sd-field textarea::placeholder { color: #94A5B8; }
.sdx .sd-form__note { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-form button { width: auto; }

/* Deutlich markierter Platzhalter für Inhalte, die noch fehlen */
.sdx .sd-todo {
  margin-top: 34px; padding: 28px 30px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-mist), var(--blue-mist) 12px, #E4EFF7 12px, #E4EFF7 24px);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft);
}
.sdx .sd-todo > b { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-deep); }
.sdx .sd-todo p b { display: inline; font-size: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; text-transform: none; color: var(--ink); }
.sdx .sd-todo p { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: #2C4257; }

/* Rechtstexte */
.sdx .sd-legal { max-width: 760px; }
.sdx .sd-legal h3 { margin-top: 40px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-legal h3:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.sdx .sd-legal p { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-legal ul { margin-top: 14px; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.sdx .sd-legal li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr; gap: 12px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-legal li::before { content: "·"; color: var(--blue); font-weight: 900; }
.sdx .sd-legal a { color: var(--blue-deep); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-soft); }
.sdx .sd-legal a:hover { color: var(--blue); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .sdx .sd-contact { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-form__row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .sdx .sd-infolist > div { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px; }
}

/* ================================================================
   18. Bausteine für SmellTest- und FAQ-Seite
   ================================================================ */
/* --- Ablaufkarten mit Nummer --- */
.sdx .sd-flow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 22px; margin-top: 56px; }
.sdx .sd-flowcard { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 34px 30px 36px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-flowcard b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--navy); color: var(--white); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; }
.sdx .sd-flowcard h3 { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-flowcard p { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.68; color: var(--muted); }

/* --- Score-Skala --- */
.sdx .sd-score { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(9, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-top: 40px; }
.sdx .sd-score span {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 62px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--blue-mist);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);
  font-size: 19px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--blue-deep);
}
.sdx .sd-score span.is-ok { background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); box-shadow: none; }
.sdx .sd-scorelegend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 28px; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-scorelegend b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.sdx .sd-scorelegend b::before { content: ""; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-scorelegend b.is-low::before { background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft); }

/* --- Gegenüberstellung Screening / Diagnose --- */
.sdx .sd-vs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; margin-top: 52px; }
.sdx .sd-vscol { border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 38px 34px 40px; }
.sdx .sd-vscol--on { background: var(--white); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-vscol--off { background: var(--tint); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-vscol h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-vscol > span { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-vscol--off > span { color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-vscol dl { margin-top: 24px; display: grid; gap: 0; }
.sdx .sd-vscol dl > div { padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-vscol dt { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-vscol dd { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink); }

/* --- FAQ --- */
.sdx .sd-faq { margin-top: 52px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-faq summary {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 26px 0; list-style: none;
  font-size: 18.5px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--navy);
}
.sdx .sd-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.sdx .sd-faq summary::after {
  content: "+"; margin-left: auto; flex: none;
  width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--blue-mist);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); line-height: 1;
}
.sdx .sd-faq details[open] summary::after { content: "–"; background: var(--blue); color: var(--white); }
.sdx .sd-faq summary:hover { color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-faq__a { padding: 0 60px 30px 0; }
.sdx .sd-faq__a p { font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-faq__a p + p { margin-top: 14px; }
.sdx .sd-faq__a cite { display: block; margin-top: 16px; font-style: normal; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); }

/* --- Fachkreis-Hinweis --- */
.sdx .sd-fach {
  background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  padding: 20px 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6;
}
.sdx .sd-fach__in { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; }
.sdx .sd-fach b { flex: none; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-soft); }

@media (max-width: 1080px) { .sdx .sd-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .sdx .sd-vs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-score { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .sdx .sd-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-score { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .sdx .sd-faq summary { font-size: 17px; padding: 22px 0; }
  .sdx .sd-faq__a { padding-right: 0; }
  .sdx .sd-fach__in { flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
}

/* ================================================================
   ONLINE-TEST – nur auf dieser Seite verwendete Bausteine.
   Alles bleibt im Wrapper .sdx gekapselt.
   ================================================================ */

/* ---------- Rahmen ---------- */
.sdx [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.sdx .sd-app { background: var(--blue-mist); padding: clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px) 0 clamp(64px, 7vw, 104px); }
.sdx .sd-app__wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }
.sdx .sd-screen { display: none; }
.sdx .sd-screen.is-on { display: block; }

/* ---------- Kopfleiste der Anwendung ---------- */
.sdx .sd-appbar {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 22px;
  padding-bottom: 20px; margin-bottom: 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.sdx .sd-appbar__id { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-appbar__id b { color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; }
.sdx .sd-appbar__out {
  margin-left: auto; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); background: transparent;
  transition: color .2s ease;
}
.sdx .sd-appbar__out:hover { color: var(--blue); }

/* ---------- Karte ---------- */
.sdx .sd-panel {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line), var(--sh-sm);
}
.sdx .sd-panel--narrow { max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; }
.sdx .sd-panel h2 { font-size: clamp(24px, 2.6vw, 32px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.018em; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-panel > p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; }
.sdx .sd-panel h2 + p { margin-top: 14px; }

/* ---------- Fortschritt ---------- */
.sdx .sd-prog { margin-bottom: 26px; }
.sdx .sd-prog__top {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
}
.sdx .sd-prog__bar { margin-top: 12px; height: 4px; background: var(--blue-soft); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; }
.sdx .sd-prog__fill { height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--blue); border-radius: 2px; transition: width .3s ease; }

/* ---------- Bildantworten ---------- */
.sdx .sd-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; margin-top: 30px; }
.sdx .sd-choice { position: relative; display: block; cursor: pointer; }
.sdx .sd-choice input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }
.sdx .sd-choice__box {
  display: grid; grid-template-rows: 1fr auto; gap: 14px; justify-items: center;
  padding: 22px 14px 18px; border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);
  transition: box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}
/* Feste Bildhöhe, damit die drei Karten trotz unterschiedlicher
   Seitenverhältnisse auf einer Linie stehen. */
.sdx .sd-choice__box img { width: 100%; max-width: 168px; height: 150px; object-fit: contain; }
.sdx .sd-choice__name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); text-align: center; }
.sdx .sd-choice:hover .sd-choice__box { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft), var(--sh-sm); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.sdx .sd-choice.is-on .sd-choice__box { background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue), var(--sh-sm); }
.sdx .sd-choice input:focus-visible + .sd-choice__box { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue), 0 0 0 4px rgba(64,123,160,.28); }

/* ---------- Auswahl Nasenseite ---------- */
.sdx .sd-side { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; }
.sdx .sd-side label { position: relative; cursor: pointer; }
.sdx .sd-side input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }
.sdx .sd-side span {
  display: block; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); transition: all .2s ease;
}
.sdx .sd-side label:hover span { color: var(--blue); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft); }
.sdx .sd-side label.is-on span { color: var(--white); background: var(--blue); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-side input:focus-visible + span { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue), 0 0 0 4px rgba(64,123,160,.28); }

/* ---------- Knopfreihe ---------- */
.sdx .sd-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 32px; }
.sdx .sd-actions .sd-btn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.sdx .sd-actions .sd-btn--primary:disabled:hover { background: var(--blue); transform: none; }
.sdx .sd-actions__right { margin-left: auto; }

/* ---------- Zusammenfassung ---------- */
.sdx .sd-sum { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; margin-top: 30px; }
.sdx .sd-sumitem {
  display: grid; gap: 8px; justify-items: center; text-align: center;
  padding: 16px 10px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); transition: box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}
.sdx .sd-sumitem:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--blue-soft), var(--sh-sm); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.sdx .sd-sumitem img { width: 74px; height: 68px; object-fit: contain; }
.sdx .sd-sumitem b { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-sumitem span { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }

/* ---------- Ergebnis ---------- */
.sdx .sd-res { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 30px; align-items: center; }
.sdx .sd-res__score {
  display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 2px;
  width: 148px; height: 148px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--blue-mist); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue-soft);
}
.sdx .sd-res__score b { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-res__score span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-res--low .sd-res__score { background: #FBECEA; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #F0C3BE; }
.sdx .sd-res__txt h2 { font-size: clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 30px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.22; letter-spacing: -.018em; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-res__txt p { margin-top: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; }

.sdx .sd-reslist { margin-top: 34px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-reslist > div {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr 1fr 30px; gap: 16px;
  align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15.5px;
}
.sdx .sd-reslist > div:first-child { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.sdx .sd-reslist b { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
.sdx .sd-reslist .sd-mark { font-weight: 900; text-align: center; color: var(--blue); }
.sdx .sd-reslist .sd-mark.is-bad { color: var(--red); }

.sdx .sd-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px 30px; margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sdx .sd-meta > div { display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 15px; }
.sdx .sd-meta dt { flex: none; width: 120px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 3px; }
.sdx .sd-meta dd { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }

/* ---------- Meldung ---------- */
.sdx .sd-msg {
  margin-top: 18px; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: #FBECEA; color: #8E2A22; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #F0C3BE;
}
.sdx .sd-msg[hidden] { display: none; }

/* ---------- Aussehen kleiner Schalter ---------- */
.sdx .sd-linkbtn { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); background: transparent; transition: color .2s ease; }
.sdx .sd-linkbtn:hover { color: var(--blue-light); }

/* ---------- Responsiv ---------- */
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .sdx .sd-sum { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .sdx .sd-meta { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sdx .sd-res { grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: start; gap: 22px; }
  .sdx .sd-reslist > div { grid-template-columns: 74px 1fr 1fr 26px; gap: 10px; font-size: 14.5px; }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .sdx .sd-app__wrap { padding: 0 20px; }
  .sdx .sd-prog__top { flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .sdx .sd-choices { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  .sdx .sd-choice__box { grid-template-rows: none; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr; justify-items: start; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 14px 18px; }
  .sdx .sd-choice__box img { max-width: 96px; height: 84px; }
  .sdx .sd-choice__name { text-align: left; }
  .sdx .sd-actions .sd-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  .sdx .sd-actions__right { margin-left: 0; }
}

  <section class="sd-phero">
    <div class="sd-wrap">
      <span class="sd-eyebrow">Online-Test</span>
      <h1 class="sd-h2" style="margin-top:18px">Smell Discettes Olfaction Test</h1>
      <p class="sd-lead" style="max-width:720px">
        Der geführte Ablauf für die Praxis: Fachperson anmelden, Patientendaten erfassen,
        die acht Disketten der Reihe nach riechen lassen und je eine von drei Bildantworten
        wählen. Am Schluss steht der Score von 0 bis 8 samt Einordnung.
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ==================================================================
       ANWENDUNG
       ================================================================== -->
  <section class="sd-app">
    <div class="sd-app__wrap">

      <!-- ---------- Kopfleiste, sichtbar sobald angemeldet ---------- -->

        <span class="sd-appbar__id">Angemeldet: <b id="sdt-bar-pruefer"></b> · <b id="sdt-bar-klinik"></b></span>
        <button type="button" class="sd-appbar__out" id="sdt-logout">Abmelden</button>
      </div>

      <!-- ============ 1. Anmeldung ============ -->
      <div class="sd-screen is-on" id="sdt-s-login">
        <div class="sd-panel sd-panel--narrow">
          <h2>Anmeldung</h2>
          <p>
            Der Online-Test richtet sich an Fachpersonen. Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem Namen,
            Ihrer Klinik oder Praxis und dem Produktcode Ihrer TestBox an.
          </p>

          <form class="sd-form" id="sdt-form-login" novalidate>
            <div class="sd-field">
              <label for="sdt-pruefer">Prüferin oder Prüfer</label>
              <input type="text" id="sdt-pruefer" name="pruefer" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Vorname und Name" required>
            </div>
            <div class="sd-field">
              <label for="sdt-klinik">Klinik oder Praxis</label>
              <input type="text" id="sdt-klinik" name="klinik" autocomplete="organization" placeholder="Ort der Testdurchführung" required>
            </div>
            <div class="sd-field">
              <label for="sdt-code">Produktcode</label>
              <input type="text" id="sdt-code" name="code" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Seriennummer der TestBox" required>
            </div>
            <p class="sd-form__note">
              Den Produktcode finden Sie auf dem Etikett der TestBox-Rückseite, neben dem
              Schweizerkreuz, als Seriennummer (SN).
            </p>
            <div class="sd-msg" id="sdt-msg-login" hidden></div>
            <div class="sd-actions" style="margin-top:8px">
              <button type="submit" class="sd-btn sd-btn--primary">Anmelden <span class="sd-btn__arrow">→</span></button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>

        <p class="sd-form__note" style="max-width:560px;margin:22px auto 0;text-align:center">
          Alle Eingaben bleiben in diesem Browser. Es werden keine Patientendaten an einen
          Server übertragen oder dort gespeichert.
        </p>
      </div>

      <!-- ============ 2. Patient anmelden ============ -->
      <div class="sd-screen" id="sdt-s-patient">
        <div class="sd-panel">
          <h2>Patient anmelden</h2>
          <p>Die Angaben erscheinen auf dem Ergebnisblatt und bleiben ausschliesslich in diesem Browser.</p>

          <form class="sd-form" id="sdt-form-patient" novalidate>
            <div class="sd-form__row">
              <div class="sd-field">
                <label for="sdt-vorname">Vorname</label>
                <input type="text" id="sdt-vorname" name="vorname" placeholder="Vorname" required>
              </div>
              <div class="sd-field">
                <label for="sdt-nachname">Nachname</label>
                <input type="text" id="sdt-nachname" name="nachname" placeholder="Nachname" required>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="sd-form__row">
              <div class="sd-field">
                <label for="sdt-geburt">Geburtsdatum</label>
                <input type="date" id="sdt-geburt" name="geburt" required>
              </div>
              <div class="sd-field">
                <label for="sdt-datum">Testdatum</label>
                <input type="date" id="sdt-datum" name="datum" required>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sd-field" style="gap:4px">
              <label id="sdt-side-label">Welche Seite der Nase (Regio olfactoria) wird getestet?</label>
              <div class="sd-side" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="sdt-side-label">
                <label class="is-on"><input type="radio" name="sdt-seite" value="Beide Nasenlöcher" checked><span>Beide Nasenlöcher</span></label>
                <label><input type="radio" name="sdt-seite" value="Rechtes Nasenloch"><span>Rechtes Nasenloch</span></label>
                <label><input type="radio" name="sdt-seite" value="Linkes Nasenloch"><span>Linkes Nasenloch</span></label>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sd-note" style="margin-top:6px">
              <b>Vor dem Testen:</b> Hände waschen und desinfizieren. Starke Allergikerinnen und
              Allergiker vertragen einzelne Gerüche möglicherweise nicht – das vorgängig klären.
              Wird eine Seite einzeln geprüft, verschliesst die Patientin oder der Patient das
              andere Nasenloch mit dem Finger.
            </div>

            <div class="sd-msg" id="sdt-msg-patient" hidden></div>

            <div class="sd-actions">
              <button type="submit" class="sd-btn sd-btn--primary">Test beginnen <span class="sd-btn__arrow">→</span></button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ============ 3. Test ============ -->
      <div class="sd-screen" id="sdt-s-quiz">
        <div class="sd-panel">
          <div class="sd-prog">
            <div class="sd-prog__top">
              <span id="sdt-prog-txt">Diskette 1 von 8</span>
              <span id="sdt-prog-pat"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="sd-prog__bar"><span class="sd-prog__fill" id="sdt-prog-fill"></span></div>
          </div>

          <h2 id="sdt-q-title">Der Patient riecht jetzt an Diskette&nbsp;1.</h2>
          <p>Wählen Sie das Bild, das dem eben gerochenen Duft am nächsten kommt.</p>

          <div class="sd-choices" id="sdt-choices" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="sdt-q-title"></div>

          <p class="sd-form__note" style="margin-top:22px">
            Wird nichts gerochen, markieren Sie die wahrscheinlichste Antwort. Danach die
            Diskette wieder gut verschliessen und in die TestBox zurücklegen.
          </p>

          <div class="sd-actions">
            <button type="button" class="sd-btn sd-btn--ghost" id="sdt-back">Zurück</button>
            <button type="button" class="sd-btn sd-btn--primary sd-actions__right" id="sdt-next" disabled>Weiter <span class="sd-btn__arrow">→</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ============ 4. Zusammenfassung ============ -->
      <div class="sd-screen" id="sdt-s-summary">
        <div class="sd-panel">
          <h2>Zusammenfassung</h2>
          <p>Prüfen Sie die acht Antworten. Ein Klick auf eine Diskette öffnet sie noch einmal.</p>

          <div class="sd-sum" id="sdt-sum"></div>

          <div class="sd-actions">
            <button type="button" class="sd-btn sd-btn--ghost" id="sdt-sum-back">Zurück zu Diskette 8</button>
            <button type="button" class="sd-btn sd-btn--primary sd-actions__right" id="sdt-finish">Test abschliessen <span class="sd-btn__arrow">→</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ============ 5. Ergebnis ============ -->
      <div class="sd-screen" id="sdt-s-result">
        <div class="sd-panel">
          <div class="sd-res" id="sdt-res">
            <div class="sd-res__score"><b id="sdt-score">0</b><span>von 8</span></div>
            <div class="sd-res__txt">
              <h2 id="sdt-res-title"></h2>
              <p id="sdt-res-text"></p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="sd-reslist" id="sdt-reslist"></div>

          <dl class="sd-meta" id="sdt-meta"></dl>

          <p class="sd-source" style="margin-top:26px">
            Bei einem Score von 7 oder 8 beträgt die statistische Sicherheit einer normalen
            Olfaktion 99,74 %. Briner &amp; Simmen, <i>Rhinology</i> 1999; 37: 145–148 (n&nbsp;=&nbsp;124).
          </p>

          <div class="sd-actions">
            <button type="button" class="sd-btn sd-btn--primary" id="sdt-print">Ergebnis drucken oder als PDF sichern</button>
            <button type="button" class="sd-btn sd-btn--ghost" id="sdt-again">Neuen Test starten</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>

<script>
/* ==================================================================
   SMELL DISCETTES – ONLINE-TEST
   Läuft vollständig im Browser. Es werden keine Daten versendet.
   ================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------
     ZUGANG
     Der Produktcode wird hier nur auf seine Form geprüft. Eine echte
     Prüfung gegen die ausgelieferten Seriennummern braucht eine
     Serverkomponente – solange die fehlt, ist diese Abfrage eine
     Zugangshürde und kein Schutz.

     codes: Liste erlaubter Codes. Bleibt sie leer, wird jeder Code
            akzeptiert, der dem Muster entspricht.
     ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var ZUGANG = {
    codes: [],
    muster: /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\- ]{6,}$/
  };

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------

     Reihenfolge und Bildauswahl entsprechen dem Testformular in der
     TestBox. Die Bildpfade werden beim Erzeugen des Elementor-Blocks
     durch eingebettete Daten ersetzt – deshalb hier vollständig
     ausgeschrieben und nicht zusammengesetzt.
     ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var FRAGEN = [
    { nr: 1, richtig: 'Kaffee', auswahl: [

      { name: 'Pfeffer',      bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' } ] },
    { nr: 4, richtig: 'Gras', auswahl: [

      { name: 'Zitrone',      bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' },
      { name: 'Gras',         bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' } ] },
    { nr: 5, richtig: 'Ananas', auswahl: [
      { name: 'Knoblauch',    bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' },
      { name: 'Ananas',       bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' },

    { nr: 6, richtig: 'Rose', auswahl: [

      { name: 'Birne',        bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' } ] },
    { nr: 7, richtig: 'Schokolade', auswahl: [

      { name: 'Kokosnuss',    bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' },
      { name: 'Schokolade',   bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' } ] },
    { nr: 8, richtig: 'Fisch', auswahl: [

      { name: 'Tabak',        bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' },
      { name: 'Essig',        bild: 'data:image/webp;base64,' } ] }
  ];

  /* ---------- Kurzformen ---------------------------------------- */
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var esc = function (t) {
    return String(t == null ? '' : t)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  };
  var speicher = (function () {
    try { var s = window.sessionStorage; s.setItem('sdt', '1'); s.removeItem('sdt'); return s; }
    catch (e) { return null; }
  })();

  /* ---------- Zustand ------------------------------------------- */
  var sitzung = null;                 // { pruefer, klinik, code }
  var patient = null;                 // { vorname, nachname, geburt, datum, seite }
  var antworten = new Array(8).fill(null);
  var aktuell = 0;

  /* ---------- Bildschirme --------------------------------------- */
  var SCREENS = ['login', 'patient', 'quiz', 'summary', 'result'];
  function zeige(name) {
    SCREENS.forEach(function (s) {
      var el = $('sdt-s-' + s);
      if (el) el.classList.toggle('is-on', s === name);
    });
    $('sdt-bar').hidden = (name === 'login');
    // Nur nach oben holen, wenn der Anwendungsbereich aus dem Bild gelaufen ist
    var app = document.querySelector('.sdx .sd-app');
    if (app && app.getBoundingClientRect().top < 0) app.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
  }

  function meldung(id, text) {
    var el = $(id);
    if (!el) return;
    if (text) { el.textContent = text; el.hidden = false; }
    else { el.textContent = ''; el.hidden = true; }
  }

  /* ---------- Anmeldung ----------------------------------------- */
  function anmelden(daten) {
    sitzung = daten;
    $('sdt-bar-pruefer').textContent = daten.pruefer;
    $('sdt-bar-klinik').textContent = daten.klinik;
    if (speicher) { try { speicher.setItem('sd-test-sitzung', JSON.stringify(daten)); } catch (e) {} }
  }

  function abmelden() {
    sitzung = null; patient = null;
    antworten = new Array(8).fill(null);
    aktuell = 0;
    if (speicher) { try { speicher.removeItem('sd-test-sitzung'); } catch (e) {} }
    $('sdt-form-login').reset();
    $('sdt-form-patient').reset();
    setzeSeite('Beide Nasenlöcher');
    heuteSetzen();
    meldung('sdt-msg-login', '');
    meldung('sdt-msg-patient', '');
    zeige('login');
  }

  $('sdt-form-login').addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    var pruefer = $('sdt-pruefer').value.trim();
    var klinik  = $('sdt-klinik').value.trim();
    var code    = $('sdt-code').value.trim();

    if (!pruefer || !klinik || !code) {
      meldung('sdt-msg-login', 'Bitte füllen Sie alle drei Felder aus.');
      return;
    }
    if (!ZUGANG.muster.test(code)) {
      meldung('sdt-msg-login', 'Der Produktcode sieht nicht wie eine Seriennummer aus. Bitte den Code vom Etikett der TestBox-Rückseite eingeben.');
      return;
    }
    if (ZUGANG.codes.length) {
      var norm = code.replace(/[\s-]/g, '').toUpperCase();
      var ok = ZUGANG.codes.some(function (c) { return c.replace(/[\s-]/g, '').toUpperCase() === norm; });
      if (!ok) {
        meldung('sdt-msg-login', 'Dieser Produktcode ist nicht freigeschaltet. Bitte prüfen Sie die Eingabe oder wenden Sie sich an info@smelldiscettes.com.');
        return;
      }
    }
    meldung('sdt-msg-login', '');
    anmelden({ pruefer: pruefer, klinik: klinik, code: code });
    zeige('patient');
  });

  $('sdt-logout').addEventListener('click', abmelden);

  /* ---------- Nasenseite ---------------------------------------- */
  function setzeSeite(wert) {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.sdx .sd-side label'), function (l) {
      var i = l.querySelector('input');
      i.checked = (i.value === wert);
      l.classList.toggle('is-on', i.checked);
    });
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.sdx .sd-side input'), function (i) {
    i.addEventListener('change', function () { setzeSeite(i.value); });
  });

  function gewaehlteSeite() {
    var i = document.querySelector('.sdx .sd-side input:checked');
    return i ? i.value : 'Beide Nasenlöcher';
  }

  /* ---------- Datum --------------------------------------------- */
  function heuteSetzen() {
    var d = new Date();
    var iso = d.getFullYear() + '-' +
      String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
      String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    $('sdt-datum').value = iso;
  }
  function datumDe(iso) {
    if (!iso) return '–';
    var t = iso.split('-');
    return t.length === 3 ? t[2] + '.' + t[1] + '.' + t[0] : iso;
  }

  /* ---------- Patient ------------------------------------------- */
  $('sdt-form-patient').addEventListener('submit', function (ev) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    var p = {
      vorname:  $('sdt-vorname').value.trim(),
      nachname: $('sdt-nachname').value.trim(),
      geburt:   $('sdt-geburt').value,
      datum:    $('sdt-datum').value,
      seite:    gewaehlteSeite()
    };
    if (!p.vorname || !p.nachname || !p.geburt || !p.datum) {
      meldung('sdt-msg-patient', 'Bitte füllen Sie Vorname, Nachname, Geburtsdatum und Testdatum aus.');
      return;
    }
    meldung('sdt-msg-patient', '');
    patient = p;
    antworten = new Array(8).fill(null);
    aktuell = 0;
    zeichneFrage();
    zeige('quiz');
  });

  /* ---------- Test ---------------------------------------------- */
  function zeichneFrage() {
    var f = FRAGEN[aktuell];
    $('sdt-prog-txt').textContent = 'Diskette ' + f.nr + ' von 8';
    $('sdt-prog-pat').textContent = patient ? patient.vorname + ' ' + patient.nachname + ' · ' + patient.seite : '';
    $('sdt-prog-fill').style.width = ((aktuell + 1) / 8 * 100) + '%';
    $('sdt-q-title').innerHTML = 'Der Patient riecht jetzt an Diskette&nbsp;' + f.nr + '.';

    var html = '';
    f.auswahl.forEach(function (a, i) {
      var an = antworten[aktuell] === a.name;
      html += '<label class="sd-choice' + (an ? ' is-on' : '') + '">' +
                '<input type="radio" name="sdt-frage' + f.nr + '" value="' + esc(a.name) + '"' + (an ? ' checked' : '') + '>' +
                '<span class="sd-choice__box">' +
                  '<img src="' + a.bild + '" alt="' + esc(a.name) + '" width="220" height="220" loading="lazy">' +
                  '<span class="sd-choice__name">' + esc(a.name) + '</span>' +
                '</span>' +
              '</label>';
    });
    $('sdt-choices').innerHTML = html;

    Array.prototype.forEach.call($('sdt-choices').querySelectorAll('input'), function (inp) {
      inp.addEventListener('change', function () {
        antworten[aktuell] = inp.value;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call($('sdt-choices').querySelectorAll('.sd-choice'), function (l) {
          l.classList.toggle('is-on', l.querySelector('input').checked);
        });
        $('sdt-next').disabled = false;
      });
    });

    $('sdt-next').disabled = !antworten[aktuell];
    $('sdt-back').textContent = aktuell === 0 ? 'Patientendaten' : 'Zurück';
    $('sdt-next').innerHTML = (aktuell === 7 ? 'Zur Zusammenfassung' : 'Weiter') + ' <span class="sd-btn__arrow">→</span>';
  }

  $('sdt-back').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (aktuell === 0) { zeige('patient'); return; }
    aktuell--; zeichneFrage();
  });

  $('sdt-next').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!antworten[aktuell]) return;
    if (aktuell === 7) { zeichneZusammenfassung(); zeige('summary'); return; }
    aktuell++; zeichneFrage();
  });

  /* ---------- Zusammenfassung ----------------------------------- */
  function bildZu(f, name) {
    for (var i = 0; i < f.auswahl.length; i++) {
      if (f.auswahl[i].name === name) return f.auswahl[i].bild;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function zeichneZusammenfassung() {
    var html = '';
    FRAGEN.forEach(function (f, i) {
      var a = antworten[i];
      html += '<button type="button" class="sd-sumitem" data-i="' + i + '">' +
                '<img src="' + bildZu(f, a) + '" alt="" width="74" height="74">' +
                '<b>Diskette ' + f.nr + '</b>' +
                '<span>' + esc(a) + '</span>' +
              '</button>';
    });
    $('sdt-sum').innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($('sdt-sum').querySelectorAll('.sd-sumitem'), function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        aktuell = parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-i'), 10);
        zeichneFrage();
        zeige('quiz');
      });
    });
  }

  $('sdt-sum-back').addEventListener('click', function () {
    aktuell = 7; zeichneFrage(); zeige('quiz');
  });

  /* ---------- Ergebnis ------------------------------------------ */
  function punkte() {
    var p = 0;
    FRAGEN.forEach(function (f, i) { if (antworten[i] === f.richtig) p++; });
    return p;
  }

  function zeichneErgebnis() {
    var p = punkte();
    var gut = p >= 7;

    $('sdt-score').textContent = p;
    $('sdt-res').classList.toggle('sd-res--low', !gut);
    $('sdt-res-title').textContent = gut
      ? 'Normales Riechvermögen'
      : 'Auffälliges Ergebnis';
    $('sdt-res-text').textContent = gut
      ? 'Bei 7 oder 8 Punkten liegt ein normales Riechvermögen vor.'
      : 'Bei 0 bis 6 Punkten liegt sehr wahrscheinlich eine Störung des Riechsinnes vor (Hyposmie, Anosmie). Möglich ist auch eine mangelnde Kooperation der Testperson. Zur Bestimmung des Ausmasses sind weiterführende Testmethoden notwendig.';

    var html = '<div><span>Diskette</span><span>Antwort</span><span>Richtige Antwort</span><span></span></div>';
    FRAGEN.forEach(function (f, i) {
      var ok = antworten[i] === f.richtig;
      html += '<div>' +
                '<b>Diskette ' + f.nr + '</b>' +
                '<span>' + esc(antworten[i]) + '</span>' +
                '<span>' + esc(f.richtig) + '</span>' +
                '<span class="sd-mark' + (ok ? '' : ' is-bad') + '">' + (ok ? '✓' : '✕') + '</span>' +
              '</div>';
    });
    $('sdt-reslist').innerHTML = html;

    var meta = [
      ['Patient',   patient.vorname + ' ' + patient.nachname],
      ['Geburtsdatum', datumDe(patient.geburt)],
      ['Testdatum', datumDe(patient.datum)],
      ['Getestet',  patient.seite],
      ['Prüfer',    sitzung.pruefer],
      ['Klinik',    sitzung.klinik]
    ];
    $('sdt-meta').innerHTML = meta.map(function (m) {
      return '<div><dt>' + esc(m[0]) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(m[1]) + '</dd></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  $('sdt-finish').addEventListener('click', function () {
    zeichneErgebnis();
    zeige('result');
  });

  $('sdt-again').addEventListener('click', function () {
    patient = null;
    antworten = new Array(8).fill(null);
    aktuell = 0;
    $('sdt-form-patient').reset();
    setzeSeite('Beide Nasenlöcher');
    heuteSetzen();
    zeige('patient');
  });

  /* ---------- Ausdruck / PDF ------------------------------------ */
  function druckDokument() {
    var p = punkte();
    var gut = p >= 7;
    var zeilen = FRAGEN.map(function (f, i) {
      var ok = antworten[i] === f.richtig;
      return '<tr><td>Diskette ' + f.nr + '</td><td>' + esc(antworten[i]) + '</td><td>' +
             esc(f.richtig) + '</td><td class="m' + (ok ? '' : ' bad') + '">' + (ok ? '✓' : '✕') + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('');

    return '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="de"><head><meta charset="utf-8">' +
      '<title>Smell Discettes Olfaction Test – Ergebnis</title><style>' +
      '@page{size:A4;margin:18mm 16mm}' +
      '*{box-sizing:border-box}' +
      'body{margin:0;font:13px/1.6 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#16233A}' +
      'h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 2px;color:#00102E}' +
      '.sub{font-size:12px;color:#5C6E85;margin:0 0 22px}' +
      '.head{border-bottom:2px solid #407BA0;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:20px}' +
      'dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 30px;margin:0 0 22px}' +
      'dl>div{display:flex;gap:10px}' +
      'dt{width:110px;flex:none;color:#5C6E85}dd{margin:0;font-weight:bold;color:#00102E}' +
      '.score{border:1px solid #E1EAF2;background:#EDF4F9;padding:14px 18px;margin:0 0 22px}' +
      '.score b{font-size:26px;color:#00102E}' +
      '.score p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:12.5px;color:#16233A}' +
      'table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:18px}' +
      'th{text-align:left;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5C6E85;border-bottom:1px solid #E1EAF2;padding:6px 4px}' +
      'td{padding:6px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #F0F4F8}' +
      'td.m{text-align:center;font-weight:bold;color:#407BA0}td.m.bad{color:#D8362C}' +
      '.foot{font-size:11px;color:#5C6E85;line-height:1.55;border-top:1px solid #E1EAF2;padding-top:12px}' +
      '.sig{margin-top:34px;display:flex;gap:40px}' +
      '.sig div{flex:1;border-top:1px solid #16233A;padding-top:6px;font-size:11px;color:#5C6E85}' +
      '</style></head><body>' +
      '<div class="head"><h1>Smell Discettes Olfaction Test</h1>' +
      '<p class="sub">Riech-Screening – Ergebnisblatt</p></div>' +
      '<dl>' +
        '<div><dt>Patient</dt><dd>' + esc(patient.vorname + ' ' + patient.nachname) + '</dd></div>' +
        '<div><dt>Geburtsdatum</dt><dd>' + esc(datumDe(patient.geburt)) + '</dd></div>' +
        '<div><dt>Testdatum</dt><dd>' + esc(datumDe(patient.datum)) + '</dd></div>' +
        '<div><dt>Getestet</dt><dd>' + esc(patient.seite) + '</dd></div>' +
        '<div><dt>Prüfer</dt><dd>' + esc(sitzung.pruefer) + '</dd></div>' +
        '<div><dt>Klinik</dt><dd>' + esc(sitzung.klinik) + '</dd></div>' +
      '</dl>' +
      '<div class="score"><b>' + p + ' von 8 Punkten</b>' +
      '<p>' + (gut
        ? 'Normales Riechvermögen (Score 7 oder 8).'
        : 'Auffälliges Ergebnis (Score 0 bis 6): Es liegt sehr wahrscheinlich eine Störung des Riechsinnes vor (Hyposmie, Anosmie). Möglich ist auch eine mangelnde Kooperation der Testperson.') +
      '</p></div>' +
      '<table><thead><tr><th>Diskette</th><th>Antwort</th><th>Richtige Antwort</th><th></th></tr></thead>' +
      '<tbody>' + zeilen + '</tbody></table>' +
      '<div class="sig"><div>Datum</div><div>Unterschrift Prüferin / Prüfer</div></div>' +
      '<p class="foot" style="margin-top:26px">' +
      'Screening, keine Diagnose. Zur Bestimmung von Grad und Art einer festgestellten ' +
      'Störung sind weiterführende Testmethoden notwendig, etwa die Bestimmung der ' +
      'Riechschwelle mit n-Butanol. Bei einem Score von 7 oder 8 beträgt die statistische ' +
      'Sicherheit einer normalen Olfaktion 99,74 % (Briner &amp; Simmen, Rhinology 1999; 37: 145–148, n = 124).<br>' +
      'SMELL Discettes GmbH · Schartenrainstrasse 22 · CH-5430 Wettingen · info@smelldiscettes.com' +
      '</p></body></html>';
  }

  $('sdt-print').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var doc = druckDokument();
    var rahmen = document.createElement('iframe');
    rahmen.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    rahmen.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0;opacity:0';
    document.body.appendChild(rahmen);
    var erledigt = false;
    function drucken() {
      if (erledigt) return;
      erledigt = true;
      try {
        rahmen.contentWindow.focus();
        rahmen.contentWindow.print();
      } catch (e) {
        var w = window.open('', '_blank');
        if (w) { w.document.write(doc); w.document.close(); w.focus(); w.print(); }
      }
      setTimeout(function () { rahmen.remove(); }, 2000);
    }
    rahmen.onload = drucken;
    var d = rahmen.contentWindow.document;
    d.open(); d.write(doc); d.close();
    // Manche Browser lösen bei document.write kein load-Ereignis aus
    setTimeout(drucken, 300);
  });

  /* ---------- Start --------------------------------------------- */
  heuteSetzen();
  if (speicher) {
    try {
      var gespeichert = JSON.parse(speicher.getItem('sd-test-sitzung') || 'null');
      if (gespeichert && gespeichert.pruefer && gespeichert.klinik) {
        anmelden(gespeichert);
        zeige('patient');
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
</script>

</div>
